info.title: zxvd JSON-RPC
info.description: zxvd-rpc/1: JSON-RPC 2.0, one request per line over a 0600 UNIX socket owned by the same user (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h). Errors: -32700 parse, -32600 invalid request or batch, -32601 unknown method, -32602 bad params, -32603 internal, -32000 libzxv status: error.data = {status: ZXV_E_* number, name: its symbolic name, class: USAGE|REFUSED|FATAL|SYSTEM}, -32010 peer request refused or failed (message says why), -32012 the method's feature is off (zxvd_ext.h X4: start zxvd with --enable FEATURE or call features.set), -32011 AIPI call refused or failed (message: the AIPI_ERR_* name and what it means), -32020 payment step refused (message says why: netting, passkey or escrow, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_pay.h), -32080 seat refused (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_seats.c: the message starts with the seats.h status name, e.g. SEAT_ERR_DENIED; a wrong login or a back-off is a result of seats.unlock, not an error), -32070 no companion yet (companion.*: the swarm has no agents). 64-bit integers (entry ids, *_minor results) travel as decimal strings. zxvd refuses to start against libzxv older than ABI 1.3. -32090 Web4 feed operation refused (message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_web4.c). -32100 power tracking is not running or the budget target is unknown (power.*, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_power.h). -32014 files.* refused (message: zxf_strerror, kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_files.h). -32013 space refused: no such space, this node's role in it may not do that, or its governance refuses the step (kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_spaces.h S1, S4). Paired phones reach the same methods over the phone link (phone.link or zxvd --phone-link, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_phone.h): zxvd.shutdown, peer.serve, jurisdiction.set, aipi.put, aipi.publish, aipi.execute, phone.*, features.set, files.*, spaces.*, play.run, play.draft and every method group are refused there with -32015, and net.command, peer.ask, currency.enable, ledger.open_account and ledger.post too unless the pairing allows posting. -32016 Playground call refused or failed (message says why, kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_rpc.h P1-P3). -32017 a codecs method (freight.*, harmonic.*, stream.*, ehop.*, web4.cid, web4.agent_card, web4.card_verify; feature "codecs", answered with the switch off) refused well-formed input: too few rows, a hash or AEAD tag that does not verify (message says why; zxvd_rpc_modules.h). Bytes travel as hex strings (*_hex).

Bond, uptime and giving have no source on this node yet and are reported as 0 with the reason. Tiers give no priority, discount or credit.

methods.name: peer.ask
methods.summary: Ask another node (found over UDP, then a TCP session: X25519 + ML-KEM-1024 key exchange, ML-DSA-87 on both sides) and pay its price plus the 0.08889% assurance fee from the peer wallet (kernel/arch/hosted/zxv_peer_host.h). Needs networking on. The daemon's loop waits while the request runs.

methods.name: swarm.earnings
methods.summary: The swarm's earnings in the owner's books (docs/ZXVD.md, zxvd_rpc.h E1-E5). After every settled market cycle the owner's account is set to the Financial capital (SWC) the owner's models hold, times rate_minor, by one balanced posting from or to the swarm market account. The accounts are null until the first settled cycle. With a books file (--books), accounts brought back at start keep their balance: the run's first cycle is the base and later cycles post only the change (E5).

currency.description: Earnings currency (default VFV, a private unit with 2 minor units; --earnings-ccy)

rate_minor.description: Minor units per SWC (--earnings-rate); a bookkeeping rate, not a market price

resumed.description: The accounts came back from the books file (E5)

methods.name: mesh.books
methods.summary: Settled peer requests in the owner's books (zxvd_rpc.h S1-S4): sales, purchases and the 0.08889% fee the node paid, in VFV, with the demo float posted as 'mesh float' when a purchase needs more than the wallet account holds. The accounts are null until the first settled request.

methods.name: books.file
methods.summary: Where the owner's books are saved (zxvd_rpc.h F1-F6): an append-only file of SHA-256-chained records, replayed at start. saved is false when the books live in memory only (no --books).

saved.description: A books file is in use

head.description: SHA-256 chain head after the last record

writable.description: False after a failed write: the books are read-only until zxvd restarts (F5)

methods.name: aipi.put
methods.summary: Store bytes (a Z-Wasm module, Z-Contract text, data) in this node's in-memory blockstore as a raw block, pinned; returns its CID. Give exactly one of hex and path (a file zxvd reads, at most 1 MiB). Offline node: nothing is announced (kernel/arch/hosted/zxvd_aipi.h Z1-Z2).

params.name: hex
params.description: the bytes as hex, at most 8000 bytes

params.name: path
params.description: a file to read instead of hex

params.name: private
params.description: seal the block at rest with this node's key (default false)

methods.name: aipi.get
methods.summary: AIPI_GET: the bytes a CID names, from the local blockstore, re-hashed before they are returned. At most 65536 bytes; a larger block is refused, not cut (Z4).

methods.name: aipi.publish
methods.summary: Publish a function descriptor (intent fn) and return its function CID. The rules of docs/AIPI.md section 3 apply: checker and cert need a checker export, cert a certifier, quorum is for the mesh only.

params.name: module
params.description: CID of the Z-Wasm module

params.name: contract
params.description: CID of the Z-Contract text the calls must keep

params.name: fuel_max
params.description: most fuel one run may use (> 0)

params.name: local_only
params.description: privacy LOCAL: the descriptor is stored sealed and the function never leaves this node (default false)

params.name: deterministic
params.description: the same input always gives the same output (default true); only deterministic public calls are memoised

methods.name: aipi.execute
methods.summary: AIPI_EXECUTE on this node: run a published function in the Z-Wasm sandbox under its contract and fuel_max, or answer from the memo of earlier results (route cache). Offline (A3): code that is not in the local blockstore fails with AIPI_ERR_OFFLINE.

params.name: args
params.description: the Z-Wasm call ABI: up to 8 signed 64-bit integers

params.name: private
params.description: the input is private: never memoised (default false)

methods.name: aipi.status
methods.summary: The AIPI node: offline, blockstore use, call counts and the sandbox's counters.

methods.name: chat.me
methods.summary: The owner's chat identity (zxvd_chat.h C1, C3, C7): the NodeID (SHA-256 of the ML-DSA-65 key), whether records are saved beside the books, how many are held, and who the owner follows.

methods.name: chat.post
methods.summary: Sign and save a public post, or a reply when reply_to names a held record (C5, C6). Text is 1..1024 bytes of UTF-8 with something besides spaces. Records stay on this device: there is no exchange with peers yet.

schema.description: the id of a held record to reply to

methods.name: chat.react
methods.summary: Sign and save a reaction (an emoji or a word, 1..32 bytes of UTF-8) to a held record (C5, C6).

schema.description: the id of a held record

methods.name: chat.follow
methods.summary: Follow or unfollow a NodeID (C7). The newest FOLLOW record decides; a repeat of the current state writes nothing.

methods.name: chat.feed
methods.summary: The held posts, best first, at most 50, ranked by what each adds over the others (social_feed.h F2-F5, the Interaction Surplus Framework) with a small freshness term. No likes, reply counts or views are read by the ranker.

methods.name: chat.thread
methods.summary: A held record and its replies in (Lamport, id) order (C5).

schema.description: the id of a held record

methods.name: iso20022.render
methods.summary: Render an ISO 20022 message with libzxv (zxvd_pay.h P1): pacs.008.001.09 or camt.053.001.08. Every value is checked by libzxv and a camt053 must reconcile (opening + booked entries = closing). Rendered only: nothing is sent. Needs the books open (-32603 otherwise).

params.name: fields
params.description: text fields; libzxv says which a kind takes

params.name: amounts
params.description: minor units of fields.ccy, which amounts and entries need

params.name: entries
params.description: camt053 statement entries

methods.name: card.check
methods.summary: Check a card number's check digit for one of the platform's networks (Damm for phoenix, Luhn for dragon, Verhoeff for thunderbird). A PAN is 2..19 decimal digits (else -32000 ZXV_E_ARG). Nothing is issued or authorized.

methods.name: netting.open
methods.summary: Open a multilateral netting cycle in one ISO 4217 currency (libzxv on the cbank cb_net engine; zxvd_pay.h P3). In memory: lost when zxvd stops. At most 8 cycles are held, open or closed. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.add
methods.summary: Add a participant to an open cycle (at most 64). Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.submit
methods.summary: Submit a payment between two participants of an open cycle. Idempotent on payment_id: the same payment again is accepted and books nothing; the same id with other parties or another amount is -32000 ZXV_E_DUPLICATE. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: netting.close
methods.summary: Close a cycle and compute each participant's net position; the positions sum to zero. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.positions
methods.summary: The net positions of a closed cycle (-32020 while it is open). Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.list
methods.summary: The cycles held, without positions. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

positions.description: once closed: in the order added, + receives, - pays

methods.name: netting.drop
methods.summary: Destroy a held cycle, open or closed. Behind the "netting" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: passkey.register
methods.summary: Register a device-bound ML-DSA-65 passkey (COSE alg -49) from its WebAuthn-shaped authenticator data (ident.h id_rp_register; zxvd_pay.h P4). In memory, at most 32. Behind the "passkeys" feature (off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: authenticator_data
params.description: with the attested credential

methods.name: passkey.verify
methods.summary: Verify an assertion for a registered passkey (ident.h id_rp_verify): the signature over the authenticator data and the client data hash, the relying party, user presence, user verification and an increasing signature counter. A refusal is -32020. Behind the "passkeys" feature (off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: client_data_hash
params.description: SHA-256 of clientDataJSON

methods.name: ledger.hold
methods.summary: Hold funds in escrow (zxvd_pay.h P5): one posting from the payer to the holder account "escrow: <CCY>" (opened with the first hold in that currency), reference "escrow N to T". Saved in the books file like any posting. Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

params.name: from
params.description: the payer's account

params.name: to
params.description: the payee's account, same currency

methods.name: ledger.release
methods.summary: Pay a held hold to its payee (reference "escrow N release"). Only the owner's call releases: there are no release conditions or counterparty signatures. Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: ledger.refund
methods.summary: Return a held hold to its payer (reference "escrow N refund"). Behind the "escrow" feature (regulated; off at start, -32012 while off).

methods.name: ledger.holds
methods.summary: Every hold, read back from the escrow accounts' entries, and each escrow account's balance against what its open holds add up to. Answers while the escrow feature is off.

unmatched.description: escrow entries that are no hold's step

methods.name: features.get
methods.summary: Every feature switch (zxvd_ext.h X3-X7): its name, whether it is on, whether it is regulated, and its method groups. All start off; with a books file, features.set changes are saved and replayed at start.

regulated.description: X5: moves or records money, credit, securities or identity data that law regulates somewhere; for tests or a licensed deployment

saved.description: X7: true when switch changes are saved in the books file

methods.name: features.set
methods.summary: Turn one feature on or off (X3, X6: its engine keeps its state); saved in the books file when there is one (X7). Methods of an off feature answer -32012.

saved.description: X7: true when the change was saved in the books file

Feature 'vault' (regulated, off by default); in-memory economy (zxvd_econ.c E1-E6). An engine refusal is -32020 with the engine's status name.

methods.name: freight.pack
methods.summary: Erasure-code bytes into one freight (kernel/src/freight): 168 UBH-168 smart packets of 21 bytes, rows 0..k-1 the data and the rest Cauchy Reed-Solomon parity over GF(2^8), so ANY k of the 168 packets rebuild it. The 64-byte header carries the payload SHA-256 and travels separately. Holographic recovery here means erasure coding, nothing more.

params.name: data_hex
params.description: the payload, at most 3360 bytes (k = 168 x 20)

params.name: k
params.description: data rows (default: the fewest that hold the payload, so the most parity)

params.name: freight_id
params.description: 64-bit id (default: the first 8 bytes, little-endian, of the payload SHA-256)

packets_hex.description: 168 packets: byte 0 the row index, 1..20 payload

methods.name: freight.unpack
methods.summary: Rebuild a freight from any k of its packets (any order; duplicates and unknown rows ignored) and check the payload SHA-256. Fewer than k distinct rows, a corrupted row or a malformed header is -32017.

params.name: header_hex
params.description: the 64-byte freight header

params.name: packets_hex
params.description: whole 21-byte packets, concatenated

methods.name: harmonic.encode
methods.summary: Pack one UBH-168 harmonic wire frame (kernel/src/harmonic/zt_harmonic_wire.h W1-W3): a tag octet (100 x sync + 10 x shell + trunk) and five 32-bit words in fixed little/big/little/big/little byte order, S+ rail in W0, W2, W4 and S- rail in W1, W3. Line coding: the pattern is public and carries no secret.

params.name: trunk
params.description: trunk 0..8 (111..999 Hz) or 9 (1111 Hz, expansion)

params.name: shell
params.description: shell depth (default 0)

params.name: sync
params.description: sync flag (default false)

params.name: s_plus
params.description: the S+ (I) rail: three words, signed Q16.16 or raw 32-bit

params.name: s_minus
params.description: the S- (Q) rail: two words

methods.name: harmonic.decode
methods.summary: Unpack a 21-octet frame and resolve it with the stateless correlation resolver (W5): UNKNOWN (all zero), NEUTRAL (idle pilot or a silent rail), TRUE, FALSE or GLUT. A stateless resolver never returns PARADOX (W7).

params.name: frame_hex
params.description: the frame

params.name: threshold_q16
params.description: correlation threshold, Q16.16 (default 4096, the endian mux's 1/16)

methods.name: stream.plan
methods.summary: Cut recorded media units into segments with the live cutter's rule (kernel/src/stream stream_vod_plan): a segment closes before the first keyframe at least target_us after its start, or before any unit once max_us have passed or max_bytes would be exceeded. Units are contiguous from offset 0.

params.name: units
params.description: at most 120 units, each [len, pts_us, keyframe]; pts_us must not go backwards

params.name: target_us
params.description: target segment duration

params.name: max_us
params.description: longest segment, >= target_us

params.name: max_bytes
params.description: largest segment (default 215040, 64 freights at k = 168)

params.name: tail_us
params.description: duration of the last unit (default 0)

methods.name: stream.segment
methods.summary: Describe one swarm-stream segment (kernel/src/stream stream_manifest_build): its IPFS CIDv1 (raw, sha2-256), the freight id derived from it and the SHA-256 of each freight that carries it. The signed manifest itself needs a signing key and is not produced here.

params.name: data_hex
params.description: the segment bytes

params.name: k
params.description: data rows per freight (default 168)

params.name: stream_id
params.description: stream id (default 0)

params.name: seq
params.description: segment number (default 0)
